hooks.name: Prompt Queue System
hooks.description: Implements a queue system for prompts using a lock file to prevent concurrent processing. Blocks new prompts while one is already being processed, and releases the lock when the session stops.

action.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),lockFile=path.join(process.cwd(),'.kiro','hooks','.prompt-queue.lock');try{if(fs.existsSync(lockFile)){const stats=fs.statSync(lockFile);const ageMs=Date.now()-stats.mtimeMs;if(ageMs>300000){fs.unlinkSync(lockFile);fs.writeFileSync(lockFile,JSON.stringify({pid:process.pid,ts:Date.now()}));process.stdout.write('Queue lock expired, acquired new lock.');process.exit(0);}process.stderr.write('A prompt is already being processed. Please wait for it to complete.');process.exit(2);}else{fs.writeFileSync(lockFile,JSON.stringify({pid:process.pid,ts:Date.now()}));process.stdout.write('Queue lock acquired.');process.exit(0);}}catch(e){process.stdout.write('Queue check passed (no lock).');process.exit(0);}"
